declarative.why: a reusable row chooser: which fields are searchable, whether one or many rows can be picked, and what each pick hands back

notLower.why: what a pick returns is a mapping of named fields; the dialog, search and selection state are client runtime the platform ships

twice.note: ONE APP ONLY: dsl-conformance-max WidgetCatalogPicker (migrated from selectors[] on 2026-11-17 with identical compiled IR). There is no second picker in the corpus.

enforced.note: this is a generator test, not a behaviour probe: it proves picker filters are emitted; ExperienceValidationTest rejects a returnMapping naming a missing field; the client's picker.js is covered by experience-client.test.mjs and the real-browser smoke
